cases.question: 华南各产品销售额
cases.sql:
SELECT T3.product_name, SUM(T1.amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales AS T1
JOIN dim_region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.region_id
JOIN dim_product AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id
WHERE T2.region_name = '华南'
GROUP BY T3.product_name;

cases.question: 各区域各品类销售额
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_region.region_name AS 区域, dim_product.category AS 品类, SUM(fact_sales.amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales
JOIN dim_region ON fact_sales.region_id = dim_region.region_id
JOIN dim_product ON fact_sales.product_id = dim_product.product_id
GROUP BY dim_region.region_name, dim_product.category;

cases.question: 各品类订单数
cases.sql:
SELECT T2.category AS 品类, COUNT(T1.sale_id) AS 订单数
FROM fact_sales AS T1
JOIN dim_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id
GROUP BY T2.category;

WHERE T2.region_name = '华东'

cases.question: 华北家电销量
